plugins.name: masthead
plugins.description: Give your book an AI editorial board: notes backed by quotes from your own text, a check for contradictions in age, date and place, simulated reader reactions, and a visual report showing where your book stands on The Wayfarer's Seven Stages. Publishify never receives your full text, and the board never changes it.

metadata.description: Tools from Publishify for authors who publish their own books.
